summary: commonweb-flow resolves a dependency from an external non-registry host with install scripts enabled
details: commonweb-flow@6.999.999's own module is trivial, but its package.json declares the dependency `linker-event-header-serial` with a direct tarball URL at https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial rather than a version range resolved via the npm registry. The npm shrinkwrap pins that same non-registry URL and marks it with `hasInstallScript: true`. Running `npm install commonweb-flow` therefore fetches an arbitrary tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and executes its lifecycle install script on the installer's machine. The content behind that URL is mutable and outside the npm registry's audit surface, giving whoever controls artifacts.yosiroute.com arbitrary code execution at install time on every machine that installs this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
